bagPolicy.summary: Guests are allowed to bring one clear bag not exceeding 14″ x 14″ x 6″ or one non-clear small clutch/purse/wallet not exceeding 5″ x 9″ x 1.5″.
allowed: One clear bag not exceeding 14″ x 14″ x 6″
One non-clear small clutch/purse/wallet not exceeding 5″ x 9″ x 1.5″
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking is available at various garages near Moody Center, with pre-purchase options recommended. Manor Garage is pre-pay only and closest to ADA parking, while Trinity Garage is a short walk away. Expect traffic disruptions due to construction and plan accordingly.

rideshare.note: Use Lot 37, the LBJ Library parking lot, for rideshare pickup and drop-off. Follow signs one block north of the venue near Red River Street and Clyde Littlefield Drive. Tell your driver which zone you are in.

concessions.note: Moody Center offers a diverse range of food and beverage options, including market-style outlets with Austin favorites. Highlights include Shaq's hand-breaded chicken sandwich, build-your-own nachos, and New York style pizza. Various beverages and snacks are available throughout the venue.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Guests who require additional assistance because of a limitation in mobility can request a wheelchair transport from the entry doors of the arena to their seating location or you may text the code word “Moody” to [69050] upon arrival to our Accessibility Drop Off for assistance.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted after you leave the venue.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Will Call is located at the Southwest corner of the facility at the intersection of Robert Dedman Drive and 20th Street. Will Call will open 2 hours prior to an event.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Enter through the West, East, or Gottesman Gates; VIP and GA Floor/Pit ticket holders may get an email naming a specific gate. West Gate A, next to the UT Team Store, is the designated accessible entrance and gives Premium members expedited entry, while suite and club members should use the H-E-B Suite Level Entrance. Inside, use the portal printed on your ticket to reach your section.
